description: This file contains definitions of simple methods related to manufacturing routing task associations within the OFBiz framework, including methods for adding and updating routing task associations as part of manufacturing workflows.

methods.name: addRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Creates a new routing task association, potentially copying an existing routing task based on parameters.

methods.name: updateRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Updates an existing routing task association after verifying there are no conflicts.
